description: Since 1987, the International Association of Physics Students has served as an umbrella organization encouraging synergy among physics students and societies worldwide.
details: Composed of territorial and local committees, IAPS today counts 34 Territorial Committees, 14 Local Committees, and over 150 Individual Members. Representing more than 90,000 students across 40+ countries, AISF acts as the Territorial Committee for Italy.
